summary: Assistant produced an in-depth design critique of the Gizmo web app, reviewing source files across App, features, packages/ui, packages/design, and app-settings. The review delivered a design-specificity verdict, scored Nielsen's 10 heuristics (31/40), catalogued cognitive load hotspots and emotional valleys (thread deletion, connection loss), named specific strengths (runtime-state-as-decoration, focus-ring system, ConfirmDialog defaults), and listed P1/P2 priority issues with file paths and fixes.
decisions: Verdict that the UI is 'Authored' (8.5/10) rather than AI-generated, based on authored CSS comments and opinionated decisions like collapsing completed tool calls into a single transparent line.
Nielsen heuristic scores totaling 31/40, with each heuristic scored 0-4 and backed by named elements from the source (e.g., StreamingIndicator for visibility of system status).
Identified type-floor violation (10px text below the stated 11px floor) in three specific files as P1.
Identified accent color #d54f35 failing AA contrast (4.20:1) and text-faint #7d8375 (3.91:1) carrying 11px semantic content as P1 accessibility failures.
Identified undefined CSS variable var(--space-7) in workspace-dashboard.css:189 silently resolving to 0 as P1.
P2 priority: thread deletion lacks undo affordance despite being more irreversible than settings reset.
P2 priority: two conflicting empty-state systems (ConversationPlaceholder.svelte is unreachable).
Flagged color-only status indicators (project-dot, session-running) as accessibility failures for screen readers.
errors: Contrast failure: --color-accent: #d54f35 measures 4.20:1 on white and 4.04:1 on surface, below the 4.5:1 AA threshold for normal text. Used for markdown links, active thread titles, and palette-selected labels.
Contrast failure: --color-text-faint: #7d8375 measures 3.91:1 on white and 3.76:1 on surface, carrying 11px semantic content (timestamps, sub-labels, streaming elapsed).
Invalid CSS: var(--space-7) referenced in workspace-dashboard.css:189 is never defined in tokens-base.css or any theme, resolving to 0 margin.

Stale documentation: AboutSettings.svelte shortcut list omits ⌘F (Find in thread) which exists in shortcuts.ts, and renders 'Ctrl/⌘' as a literal string instead of using shortcutHint()'s platform detection.
Off-scale radii: Composer uses 14px and agent-question uses 13px, both off the 4/6/10/16 scale with no stated reason.

Type floor violation: 10px text used in composer-parts/editor.css:109, dialogs-parts/command-palette.css:83, and dialogs-parts/workspace-picker.css:232 despite tokens-base.css stating 11px is the floor.
